messages:
Emily: Morning — seeing apiserver heartbeats jittering in ap-northeast1, controller-manager leader flips, and a bunch of GPU attach failures. Alert: APISERVER_HEARTBEAT_JITTER triggered.
SRE-Bot: Alert fired: APISERVER_HEARTBEAT_JITTER — 17m ago. Triage runbook recommended.
Alex: I'm pulling VPC metrics now. Initial guess: NAT/SNAT exhaustion causing intermittent egress/DNS failures.
Jin: Can you paste the recent apiserver/controller-manager logs and any pod events?
Emily: Pasting small log window:
```
E0320 10:02:11.123456 1 apiserver.go:251] dial tcp 10.0.0.2:6443: i/o timeout
W0320 10:02:12.789012 1 lease.go:234] controller-manager lost lease, attempt re-election
E0320 10:02:14.001234 1 attach.go:99] attach failed for pod gpu-train-xyz: context deadline exceeded
```
Maria: Cloud NAT graphs show SNAT port usage peaked at 99% between 09:58-10:05 in ap-northeast1. DNS queries to our internal resolver show spikes and timeouts.
Tim: That pattern fits: resolver failures -> apiserver & controllers retry aggressively -> lots of short-lived TCP egress -> SNAT exhaustion -> cascading failures. Also seen controller-manager leader churn.
Alex: Short mitigation steps I'm doing now: 1) add an extra NAT gateway (fast failover), 2) increase resolver cache TTL to 60s for affected nodes, 3) patch kube-controller-manager flags to bump `--leader-elect-lease-duration` + small backoff tweak.
Emily: Rolling the NAT add now, and will patch node DNS config via daemonset.
Jin: Also throttling autoscaler: it kept launching GPU nodes for Pending pods while attach was failing, so we have idle GPUs and cost spike. Recommend pausing cluster-autoscaler in the region for 15m.
Maria: Agree. I've opened a billing watch and estimated the idle GPU cost: ~12h * current fleet => ~6k USD if not reclaimed.
Tim: Medium-term fixes: split controlplane egress to a separate NAT pool, add SNAT port scaling rules, and add more resilient DNS (multi-resolver with longer TTLs). Also consider making kubelet/controller-manager backoffs less aggressive on dial errors (so we don't amplify SNAT usage).
Alex: Filed infra task: INFRA-7823 to add NAT autoscaling + monitor SNAT headroom.
SRE-Bot: Created incident ticket: INC-2026, runbook step link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apiserver-egress-snat.
Emily: After NAT is up and TTL bumped, heartbeats look to be calming. Will follow up with a short RCA later today and a postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
